scheme_name: Scheme of Giving Awards to Eminent Artists - Kalai Nanmani Award
description:
The Kalai Nanmani Award is a prestigious recognition scheme initiated by the Government of Tamil Nadu. 

This scheme was launched in the year 1981. 

It aims to honor and acknowledge the contributions of eminent artists in the field of fine arts. 

The award is specifically targeted towards artists who have made significant contributions to Tamil culture and heritage. 

The primary objective of the Kalai Nanmani Award is to promote and preserve Tamil art forms. 

It seeks to encourage artists to continue their work and inspire future generations. 

The award also aims to enhance the visibility of Tamil art on national and international platforms. 

Each year, the Government of Tamil Nadu selects deserving artists for this honor. 

The award includes a cash prize of INR 1,00,000. 

In addition to the cash prize, recipients also receive a certificate of appreciation. 

The award is presented during the annual Tamil Nadu State Arts and Culture Festival. 

This festival usually takes place in the month of December. 

The selection process for the award involves a thorough evaluation of the artist's contributions. 

A committee of experts in the field of arts is formed to review nominations. 

The committee assesses the artistic merit and impact of the work presented by the nominees. 

Artists from various disciplines such as music, dance, drama, and visual arts are eligible for nomination. 

The award is open to both established and emerging artists. 

There are no specific age limits for eligibility. 

However, artists must have a proven track record of at least 10 years in their respective fields. 

The income criteria for eligibility are not strictly defined. 

However, preference is often given to artists who have dedicated their lives to the arts. 

Nominations can be submitted by individuals or organizations. 

The application process requires the submission of a detailed portfolio of the artist's work. 

This portfolio should showcase the artist's achievements and contributions to the field. 

Nominees must also provide a recommendation letter from a recognized authority in the arts. 

The deadline for nominations is typically set for the end of September each year. 

Once the nominations are received, the selection committee reviews them. 

The final decision is made by the end of October. 

The awards are then presented in a formal ceremony in December. 

The Kalai Nanmani Award has been instrumental in promoting Tamil culture. 

It has recognized numerous artists who have excelled in their fields. 

Over the years, the award has helped elevate the status of Tamil arts. 

It has also provided financial support to many artists. 

The award serves as a motivation for artists to continue their work. 

It encourages them to explore new avenues in their artistic expressions. 

The Government of Tamil Nadu has allocated a budget for this award every year. 

This budget ensures that the cash prize and associated expenses are covered. 

The award also garners media attention, further promoting the artists' work. 

The Kalai Nanmani Award has become a symbol of excellence in Tamil arts. 

It has fostered a sense of pride among artists in Tamil Nadu. 

The award is recognized not only in Tamil Nadu but also across India. 

Many recipients have gone on to achieve national and international acclaim. 

The award has also inspired similar initiatives in other states. 

It highlights the importance of recognizing artistic contributions to society. 

The Kalai Nanmani Award is administered by the Tamil Nadu Department of Arts and Culture. 

This department oversees the nomination and selection process. 

It also manages the disbursement of the cash prize to the awardees. 

The contact details for the Department of Arts and Culture are available on the official Tamil Nadu government website. 

Artists interested in applying or nominating someone can find information there. 

The award has a significant impact on the careers of many artists. 

It provides them with a platform to showcase their work. 

The recognition often leads to more opportunities for performances and exhibitions. 

The Kalai Nanmani Award is a vital part of Tamil Nadu's cultural landscape. 

It continues to celebrate and promote the rich artistic heritage of the state. 

The award not only honors individual artists but also emphasizes the collective cultural identity of Tamil Nadu. 

It plays a crucial role in ensuring that traditional art forms are preserved and promoted. 

The Kalai Nanmani Award is a testament to the state's commitment to the arts. 

It reflects the importance of cultural heritage in the development of society. 

The award has become a beacon of hope for many aspiring artists. 

It encourages them to pursue their passion and contribute to the arts. 

The Kalai Nanmani Award is more than just an award; it is a celebration of creativity and talent. 

It fosters a community of artists who support and uplift one another. 

The award has a lasting legacy that will continue to inspire future generations. 

Through this initiative, the Government of Tamil Nadu demonstrates its dedication to the arts. 

The Kalai Nanmani Award remains a vital part of the state's cultural policy. 

It is a significant step towards recognizing the invaluable contributions of artists. 

The award serves as a reminder of the importance of art in society. 

It highlights the need for continued support and recognition of artists in all fields. 

The Kalai Nanmani Award is a proud tradition that enriches the cultural fabric of Tamil Nadu.
